description: Source code implementing a test harness for hashmap performance testing, including functions for creating, comparing, and managing hashmap entries, as well as a command-line interface for executing performance tests.

methods.name: test_entry_cmp
methods.description: Compares two hashmap entries or a key with an entry, optionally ignoring case.

methods.name: alloc_test_entry
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new test hashmap entry with a given hash, key, and value.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Computes a hash value based on the specified method, index, and key.

methods.name: perf_hashmap
methods.description: Performs performance testing of hashmap add and lookup operations with specified method and rounds.

methods.name: cmd__hashmap
methods.description: Command-line interface for executing hashmap performance tests based on stdin commands.
